import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))

"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at the last whole word and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - 3
    if budget <= 0:
        return "..."[:max(limit, 0)]
    # Keep text[:budget] only if the cut falls on a word boundary.
    if text[budget].isspace():
        head = text[:budget]
    else:
        head = text[:budget].rsplit(None, 1)[0] if text[:budget].split() else ""
        if not head:
            return "..."
    return head.rstrip() + "..."
EOF

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
